independence: Only the source paper raster was read. No WSPRadar outputs or implementation files were inspected. Source-only zooms and dark-pixel component centroids were used.
selection_rule: Scan chronologically, selecting the first eligible negative extreme, then the first eligible positive extreme after it, then the first eligible negative extreme after that. Eligibility requires the full +/-2 pixel vertical interval to lie below -10 dB or above +20 dB, at least 20 pixels to another identified black-dot centroid, and more than 10 pixels to colored contours and axes. This alternating-sign rule addresses the incompatibility between literal first-three selection and distinct signs: the literal first three extremes are all negative. No comparison with computed outputs informed selection.
selection_limit: The chronological rule takes precedence over the preference for wide coverage of the day. All three selected points occur before 08 UTC.
centroid_method: Mean coordinates of the 8-connected dark-pixel component near the independently selected visual dot, with all RGB channels below 80. Decimal coordinates describe raster arithmetic, not physical measurement precision.

recommended_comparison_tolerance.reason: Conservatively includes annotation and approximate axis-calibration uncertainty. Declare this before comparing outputs.

interpretation_limit: These annotations test existence of a plotted UTC-hour and Delta-SNR combination within declared tolerances. The figure does not identify the date or complete station-path evidence for an individual point. Agreement cannot establish complete identity, pairing provenance, or correctness of the full distribution.
